name: prometheus-essential
description: Prometheus with the latest Essential release on each Minecraft version and loader it ships for on Modrinth, against cm-replay on loopback instead of Essential's servers: no account and no Mojang sign-in. cm-replay and its recording come from minecraft-essential-data's snapshot branch (recorded hourly). prometheus.verity.cm points Essential at cm-replay (VerityChecks.redirect), and minecraft.api.session.host sends its pre-connect Mojang join to cm-replay too. CI writes the latest Essential version in; the one here is only for local runs. Prometheus crashes on Essential 1.4.1.1, so only targets with that exact build run.
